title: How our family survives busy mornings
L: My two kids make every morning feel like a race.
My daughter Mia is seven, and my son Leo is three.
Mia wakes up early, but Leo hates getting out of bed.
Last month my wife and I tried a new routine, and it really helped.
First, we pick out clothes and pack school bags the night before.
Second, Mia helps her little brother get dressed, which makes her feel proud.
Third, we leave the phones in a basket until breakfast is over.
Now we leave the house by seven thirty, and nobody shouts any more.
Parenting is never easy, but small habits make mornings calmer.
